name: Shenzhen FRD Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen FRD Science & Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, production, and sale of electromagnetic shielding and thermal materials and devices in China and internationally. It offers EMI shielding materials, including fabric over and conductive foams, metal shielding products, electrically conductive elastomers, and microwave absorbers; robot products, such as dexterous hands, joint modules, and high-speed maglev pumps; and HP-RTM composites and semi-solid die casting.
